sentences.en: MAN: Greek Island Holidays, can help you?
sentences.zh: MAN: 希腊岛屿度假公司，有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, I hope so.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，希望如此。

sentences.en: I have a friend who's just come back from Corfu and she's recommended some apartments in Arilas.
sentences.zh: 我有个朋友刚从科孚岛回来，她推荐了阿里拉斯镇的一些公寓。

sentences.en: She thought they might be on your list.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这些公寓可能在你们的房源列表上。

sentences.en: MAN: Arilas, Arilas, let me see.
sentences.zh: MAN: 阿里拉斯，阿里拉斯，让我查一下。

sentences.en: Can you give me the names?
sentences.zh: 您能告诉我这些公寓的名字吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, the first's Rose Garden Apartments.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，第一个叫玫瑰园公寓。

sentences.en: I'd like to go with another friend in the last week of October.
sentences.zh: 我想和另一位朋友在十月的最后一周去那里。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, we've got a lovely studio flat available at that time.
sentences.zh: MAN: 呃，我们正好在那段时间有一套非常漂亮的单间公寓可供预订。

sentences.en: I'm sure you'd enjoy the entertainment programme there too, with Greek dancing in the Example restaurant.
sentences.zh: 我相信您也会喜欢那里的娱乐项目，比如在“示例”餐厅欣赏希腊舞蹈表演。

sentences.en: WOMAN.
sentences.zh: WOMAN:

sentences.en: And the cost for each of us?
sentences.zh: 那么我们每人需要多少钱？
MAN: 219英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That sounds very reasonable!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来非常合理！

sentences.en: I'm just jotting down some notes.
sentences.zh: 我正在记一些笔记。

sentences.en: Now the second one she mentioned was called Blue Bay.
sentences.zh: 第二个她提到的叫蓝湾公寓。

sentences.en: MAN: Blue Bay?
sentences.zh: MAN: 蓝湾公寓？

sentences.en: Yes, in fact that's very popular and it has some special features.
sentences.zh: 是的，实际上它非常受欢迎，而且拥有一些特别设施。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Really?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 真的吗？

sentences.en: MAN: The main attraction is the large swimming pool with salt water.
sentences.zh: MAN: 主要亮点是一个大型咸水游泳池。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Much healthier, I understand.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我听说咸水对健康更有益。

sentences.en: MAN: That's right.
sentences.zh: MAN: 没错。

sentences.en: And it isn't far from the beach, either - only 300 metres, and only around half a kilometre to some shops, so you don't have to be too energetic.
sentences.zh: 而且它离海滩也不远——仅300米；到一些商店也只需约半公里，所以您不必太费力奔波。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Is it much more expensive than the first one?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 它比第一家贵很多吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Let me just check. think at the time you want to go it's around £260 - no £275 to be exact.
sentences.zh: MAN: 让我查一下。我想您想入住的时间段价格大约是260英镑——不，准确说是275英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, I've got that.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，我记下了。

sentences.en: Now there are just two more apartments to ask you about.
sentences.zh: 现在还有两套公寓想向您咨询。

sentences.en: Um, I can't read my own writing!
sentences.zh: 嗯，我自己的字迹有点看不清了！

sentences.en: Something to do with sun Sunshine, is it?
sentences.zh: 好像是跟‘阳光’有关……是‘阳光’吗？

sentences.en: MAN: I think you meant the Sunshade Apartments.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我想您指的是遮阳伞公寓。

sentences.en: They're on a mountainside.
sentences.zh: 它们位于山坡上。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Any special features?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 有什么特别之处吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, each room has its own sun terrace and there are shared barbecue facilities.
sentences.zh: MAN: 有的，每间客房都配有独立的日光露台，并设有共用烧烤设施。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sounds lovely!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来真棒！

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, it is rather well-equipped.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，配套设施相当完善。

sentences.en: It also provides water sports - it has its it own beach.
sentences.zh: 此外还提供水上运动项目——它拥有自己的私人海滩。

sentences.en: There are facilities for water-skiing.
sentences.zh: 有滑水设施。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Any kite-surfing?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 有风筝冲浪吗？

sentences.en: My friend's quite keen.
sentences.zh: 我朋友对此很感兴趣。

sentences.en: MAN: Not at the hotel but I'm sure you'll find some in Arilas.
sentences.zh: MAN: 酒店内没有，但我相信您在阿里拉斯一定能找到相关服务。

sentences.en: There's also satellite TV in the apartments.
sentences.zh: 公寓里还配有卫星电视。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And how much is that one?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那一套多少钱？

sentences.en: MAN: £490 with two sharing.
sentences.zh: MAN: 490英镑，需两人合住。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You mean £245 each?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您的意思是每人245英镑？

sentences.en: MAN: I'm afraid not!
sentences.zh: MAN: 恐怕不是！

sentences.en: Each person has to pay that amount and there must be at least two in an apartment.
sentences.zh: 每位住客都须支付该金额，且每套公寓至少需入住两人。

sentences.en: WOMAN: I don't think that would be within our budget, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 很遗憾，这恐怕超出了我们的预算。

sentences.en: And the last one sounds a bit expensive too - the Grand!
sentences.zh: 而且最后一套——‘宏伟酒店’听起来也略显昂贵。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿

sentences.en: MAN: 15 31 19 Actually it's quite reasonable.
sentences.zh: MAN: 15 31 19 实际上价格相当合理。

sentences.en: It's an older style house with Greek paintings in every room, and a balcony outside.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋老式住宅，每个房间都装饰有希腊风格壁画，并带有一个室外阳台。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Sounds nice.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: What are the views like?
sentences.zh: 景观如何？

sentences.en: MAN: TopSage.com Well, there are forests all round and they hide a supermarket just down the road, so that's very useful for all your shopping needs.
sentences.zh: MAN: TopSage.com 周围全是森林，森林掩映着马路下方的一家超市，因此购物非常方便。

sentences.en: There's a disco in the area too.
sentences.zh: 附近还有一家迪斯科舞厅。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And the price?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那价格呢？

sentences.en: MAN: £319 at that time, but if you leave it till November it goes down by 40%.
sentences.zh: MAN: 当时是319英镑，但如果等到11月，价格会下降40%。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Too late, I'm afraid.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 恐怕为时已晚。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, why don't I send you a brochure with full details, Ms ... ?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么，纳什女士，我给您寄一份详尽的宣传册如何？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Nash.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 纳什（Nash）。

sentences.en: But don't worry about that.
sentences.zh: 不过您不必担心这个。

sentences.en: I'm coming to Upminster soon and I'll call and get one.
sentences.zh: 我很快就要去阿平厄姆（Upminster），届时我会打电话索取一份。

sentences.en: I just wanted to get an idea first.
sentences.zh: 我只是想先大致了解一下情况。

sentences.en: MAN: Well, that's fine.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: We've got plenty here when you come.
sentences.zh: 您来的时候，我们这里备有充足的宣传册。

sentences.en: WOMAN: If you've got a minute, could I just check a couple of points about insurance?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 如果您方便的话，我可以再确认几个关于保险的问题吗？

sentences.en: I got one policy through the post but I'd like to see if yours is better.
sentences.zh: 我之前通过邮局收到了一份保单，但想看看您的是否更优。

sentences.en: MAN: Fine.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: What would you like to know?
sentences.zh: 您想了解哪些方面？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, the one I've got has benefits and then the maximum amount you can claim.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，我这份保单列明了各项保障权益以及最高索赔额度。

sentences.en: Is that like yours?
sentences.zh: 您的保单也是这样吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, that's how most of them are.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，大多数保单都是如此设计。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, the first thing is cancellation.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 首先，我想了解取消行程的保障。

sentences.en: If the holiday's cancelled on the policy I've got, you can claim £8,000.
sentences.zh: 根据我这份保单，若假期被取消，可索赔8,000英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: We can improve on that, Ms Nash.
sentences.zh: MAN: 纳什女士，这方面我们可以做得更好。

sentences.en: For Greek Island holidays, our maximum is £10.000.
sentences.zh: 针对希腊岛屿度假，我们的最高索赔额为10,000英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's good of course our holiday won't even cost £1,000 together!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 这很好，当然，我们整个假期的总花费甚至不到1,000英镑！

sentences.en: MAN: It's still sensible to have good cover.
sentences.zh: MAN: 但拥有充分的保障仍是明智之举。

sentences.en: Now, if you go to hospital, we allow £600.
sentences.zh: 另外，若您住院治疗，我们可赔付600英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, mine's similar.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我这份保单的额度也类似。

sentences.en: MAN: And we also allow a relative to travel to your holiday resort.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我们还允许您的亲属前往您的度假胜地。

sentences.en: WOMAN: My policy just says their representative will help you.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我的保单上只写着他们的代表会为您提供帮助。

sentences.en: MAN: You can see there's another difference there.
sentences.zh: MAN: 您可以看到，这里还有另一项差异。

sentences.en: And what happens if you
sentences.zh: 那么，如果发生以下情况会怎样？

sentences.en: WOMAN: don't get on the plane?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您未能登机？

sentences.en: Nothing, as far as I can see on this form.
sentences.zh: 据我从这份表格上所见，不会发生任何事。

sentences.en: MAN: Don't you have missed departure?
sentences.zh: MAN: 您没有‘错过出发’这一保障项目吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: No, I'll just jot that down.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 没有，我这就把它记下来。

sentences.en: MAN: We pay up to £1,000 for that, depending on the reason.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我们对此最高赔付1000英镑，具体金额视原因而定。

sentences.en: And we're particularly generous about loss of personal belongings - up to £3,000, but not more than £500 for a single item.
sentences.zh: 对于个人物品遗失，我们的赔付尤为慷慨——最高可达3000英镑，但单件物品赔付不超过500英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Then I'd better not take my laptop!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那我最好别带笔记本电脑了！

sentences.en: MAN: Not unless you insure it separately.
sentences.zh: MAN: 除非您为其单独投保。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK - thanks very much for your time - you've really been helpful.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的——非常感谢您抽出时间——您真的帮了大忙。

sentences.en: Can I get back to you?
sentences.zh: 我可以稍后再与您联系吗？

sentences.en: Your name is?
sentences.zh: 您的姓名是？

sentences.en: MAN: Ben - Ludlow.
sentences.zh: MAN: 本——卢德洛。

sentences.en: That's L-U-D-L-O-W.
sentences.zh: 拼写为L-U-D-L-O-W。

sentences.en: I'm the Assistant Manager here.
sentences.zh: 我是这里的助理经理。

sentences.en: I'll give you my number.
sentences.zh: 我给您留一下我的电话号码。

sentences.en: WOMAN: But didn't I phone 081260 567294?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 但我之前拨打的是081260 567294，不是吗？

sentences.en: That's what I've got on the paper.
sentences.zh: 纸上写的正是这个号码。

sentences.en: MAN: That's the main switchboard.
sentences.zh: MAN: 那是总机号码。

sentences.en: I've given you my direct line.
sentences.zh: 我给您提供的是我的直线电话。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right, thank you www.TopSage.com
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，谢谢。www.TopSage.com
